doctrines.note: Two independent capture paths of this same card (house-cards/yorkist-household-knights.md via OneMoreTime direct, and the untracked top-level knowledge/vets-and-docs/yorkist-household-knights.md via Immortals-server forward) match node-for-node and line-for-line — treated as one source per unit-db-sources.md §6, not two competing ones. Card header literally reads 'Yorkist Cavlary,' not 'Household Knights'; identity match is HIGH-confidence (corroborated by a #meta-units tier-board portrait labeled '...orkist Household Knigh[t]' and the absence of any competing 'Yorkist'-named unit) but not 1:1 icon-confirmed — see identityProvenance for the naming-mismatch flag. Amya guide's example build: Epic Leadership Doctrine, Unit Damage Doctrine V, Yorkist Household Knights: Oathbound, Epic Combat Doctrine (3/6/9), Hero Damage Doctrine V. Amya notes many doctrine combinations work as long as Unit Damage V + a movement-speed doctrine are included. [VERIFY: Jasper] doctrine 5's illegible final clause (same recurring StarBurst card-clipping issue as Iron Reapers and Liao Rangers).

steps.text: Multiple spells: 1 = dismount, 2 = charge, 3 = follow-commander charge. Cover Commander is the main way to play — stay near it until it dies. Dismount situations are now rare (only vs anti-cav units that can disrupt).
Charge in with spell 2 into dismount — better success rate than Cover Commander alone.

Absolute best-in-class on ground. Don't hesitate to dismount and press spell 2. Keep the hero frontline but not far from the unit, or the unit stops attacking and just runs — test engagement range in custom games.
Cover Commander can be a bit bugged at the start — don't spam it. When flanking, turn it ON beforehand and confirm it's glowing red.

After dismounting and activating spell 2, enemies will run at the unit and it grants strong defense (duration 15s). Don't X-move or use spell V or the buff cancels — keep the unit close to the hero, don't run too far.
